title: FIGARO3 - Full-term infants' stress, gaze and regulation in father-infant-observations
summary: With the present study we want to systematically investigate the complex interplay of well-being, interaction and bonding of father and infants as well as the early interpersonal and emotional development of full-term infants. For this purpose, we will record and analyze father-infant-interactions. Furthermore, we will collect questionnaires that allow additional statements about father-infant-interaction and bonding, the overall stress level and other important fctors. The study will take place at the Institute of Experimental Pschology of the Heinrich-Heine-University in Düsseldorf. We will include full-term infants (i.e. infants born after week 37 of gestation) in the study.
conditions: Perinatal mental health problems of parents

interventions.name: Infants and fathers are mutually interacting during the 3x 2 minute still face paradigm. Prior to the observations, three pooled saliva samples will be assessed of fathers for the analysis of momentary testosterone, progesterone and cortisone levels. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Infants born after week 37/0 of gestation; Written informed consent of the participating father and other caregiver to participate in the study, Age of the father and other caregiver ≥ 18 years; Sufficient knowledge of the German language to ensure that the information sheet as well as the consent form and the oral information about the study are understood.
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of mental, physical or linguistic ability of the father that does not allow participation; Known serious illnesses or congenital developmental disorders of the infant.
